title: Milo's Cafe: a neighborhood site with a live patio
summaryLead: A one-page café site: the menu, whether it is open, and whether the patio is worth it today.

features.title: One page, two actions
features.text: Order buttons go to SpotOn, and a sticky Order and Call bar keeps both in reach.

features.title: Live patio scene
features.text: An SVG scene follows time of day and weather, with a feels-like verdict and a day slider.
features.alt: Milo's patio scene at golden hour

features.title: Searchable menu
features.text: 69 items as data, with live search, a meat-free filter and guest favourites.
features.alt: Milo's menu with Food and Drinks tabs

features.title: Pair it
features.text: Pick a food mood and a drink mood and it suggests a combination.
